meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 配置并校验计算流体仿真,让模拟稳定可靠、安全续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用计算流体仿真做科研数值模拟,需要确认设置准确并安全重启任务
copy.tagline_en: Set up and validate fluid-flow simulations for stable, safe runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run computational fluid dynamics simulations and need sound setup and safe restarts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 FluidSim 这个 Python 计算流体力学框架帮你干活：挑选求解器、逐项配置参数、启动模拟，并分析输出——画出速度/涡度场、能谱和空间平均值曲线。可处理的方程包括 2D/3D Navier-Stokes、浅水方程、分层流等。
howto.when: 当你要求运行流体力学模拟（如 2D/3D Navier-Stokes、浅水流动等）、挑选或配置 FluidSim 求解器与参数，或分析已有的模拟输出结果时触发。

say.text: 用 ns2d 求解器跑一个 256×256 的二维湍流模拟
say.note: 会建好参数对象并执行到设定的结束时间

say.text: 把 params.nu_2 改成 1e-4，然后启动模拟
say.note: 按新黏度系数重新运行

say.text: 加载上次的模拟结果，画出涡度场
say.note: 用 load_sim_for_plot 读取并绘图

howto.what_en: Claude uses FluidSim, a Python CFD framework, to pick solvers, configure parameters, run simulations, and analyze output — plotting velocity/vorticity fields, spectra, and spatial means. Solvers cover 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, and stratified flows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run a fluid dynamics simulation (2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, etc.), select or configure a FluidSim solver and its parameters, or analyze existing simulation output.

say_en.text: Run a 2D turbulence simulation with the ns2d solver at 256x256
say_en.note: Builds params and runs to t_end

say_en.text: Set params.nu_2 to 1e-4 and start the simulation
say_en.note: Runs again with the new viscosity

say_en.text: Load the previous simulation and plot the vorticity field
